subsequent_commits.message: removed key editing in setup phase

Replace threema.gateway SDK with native pynacl + aiohttp implementation

Drops the unmaintained threema.gateway (which depends on the also-unmaintained
libnacl) in favour of a direct Threema Gateway API implementation using
PyNaCl (already a core dependency) and HA's shared aiohttp session.

- Implements simple and E2E text message sending per the Threema protocol spec
- Generates key pairs via nacl.public.PrivateKey.generate()
- Aligns PyNaCl requirement to the version already used by mobile_app/owntracks
- Rewrites all mocks to use method-level patches instead of SDK class patches
- Adds test_client.py with unit tests covering all HTTP paths and crypto logic

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <<email>>

Address Copilot review: password selectors, key clearing, strings cleanup

- Mask api_secret and private_key with TextSelector PASSWORD type
- Always overwrite self._private_key/public_key from form input so clearing
  a key field on re-entry after an error takes effect
- Update key data_description to reflect plain hex format (drop stale
  'private:' / 'public:' prefix hints from old SDK)
- Clarify setup_new description: keys are already hex, no prefix to strip

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <<email>>

Remove requirements_test_all.txt — deleted from upstream dev

Upstream home-assistant/core removed this file. Drop it from our branch
to resolve the delete/modify conflict in the PR.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <<email>>

Address Copilot review: reauth flow, hex pubkey decode, E2E fix, silver quality scale

- Fix critical bug: /pubkeys endpoint returns hex not base64; all E2E sends
  were failing with a PyNaCl key-length error
- Add async_step_reauth + async_step_reauth_confirm so users can fix expired
  credentials without deleting the config entry
- notify.py: call entry.async_start_reauth() on ThreemaAuthError so HA
  surfaces the reauth UI on runtime auth failures; map to invalid_auth key
- notify.py: consolidate duplicate except blocks into one handler
- config_flow.py: remove CONF_PUBLIC_KEY from credentials form and entry data
  (public key is shown in setup_new for copy but never needed at runtime)
- manifest.json: quality_scale bronze -> silver
- quality_scale.yaml: reauthentication-flow and strict-typing marked done
- tests: add reauth flow tests (success + 3 error cases), auth-error-triggers-
  reauth test in notify, fix pubkey mock from base64 to hex

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <<email>>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01EAZnrsMgdMQnTzEqUhuCnD

Normalize translations/en.json formatting (hassfest)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <<email>>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01EAZnrsMgdMQnTzEqUhuCnD
Updated UI flow and key mechanism

Remove reauth flow, defer to feature/threema-reauth

joostlek requested new integrations keep reauth out to reduce review
scope. The full implementation (config flow reauth steps, notify
runtime trigger, tests, translations, silver quality scale) is
preserved on feature/threema-reauth for a follow-up PR.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <<email>>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01EAZnrsMgdMQnTzEqUhuCnD

Migrate to probatio, sync with dev, simplify test_client.py

- voluptuous -> probatio: dev banned direct voluptuous imports in
  favor of the new probatio library; verified as a functional
  drop-in (bare `import probatio`, not aliased as `vol` per the
  new banned-aliases rule).
- Merged upstream/dev (2139 commits) so local type-checking matches
  what CI actually validates against (the PR's merge-ref).
- Fixed test_notify.py's use of the now-deprecated
  DeviceEntry.config_entries_subentries in favor of
  config_entry_id/config_subentry_id.
- Replaced test_client.py's full protocol test suite (duplicated
  from aiothreema, per Copilot review) with focused tests of only
  what ThreemaAPIClient itself does: wiring Home Assistant's shared
  aiohttp session into the library.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <<email>>

+def _strip_key_prefix(value: str, expected_prefix: str) -> str | None:
+    """Strip the expected Threema key-export prefix, if present.
+
+    Returns None if the value carries a *different* key-type prefix (e.g.
+    a 'public:' key pasted into the private-key field), so the mismatch
+    can be rejected instead of silently accepted as the wrong key type.
+    """
+    lowered = value.lower()
+    for prefix in _KEY_PREFIXES:
+        if lowered.startswith(prefix):
+            if prefix != expected_prefix:
+                return None
+            return value[len(prefix) :].strip()
+    return value
+
+
+def _is_valid_key_hex(value: str) -> bool:
+    """Return True if value is a 64-character hex string (32-byte NaCl key)."""
+    if len(value) != _KEY_HEX_LENGTH:
+        return False
+    try:
+        bytes.fromhex(value)
+    except ValueError:
+        return False
+    return True
+
